notes.title: Your feedback made it into the game!
notes.content:
[h1]Lovely hoomans![/h1]

After the initial launch of the demo we gathered a ton of valuable [b]feedback from YOU[/b] and now some of that made it into the demo:
[list]
[*] Added a pause menu that can be accessed using "Esc".
[*] "Exit button" in inventory closes the inventory instead of taking you to the main menu.
[*] Increased walking speed. No running animation yet but I'm tempted to create a skip cycle animation  for the full game! Personally I call it skippety-hop which I learned was not correct Thoughts? 
[*] Chick Edvins obsession with shiny things is not as random anymore!
[*] Added missing translations for the save and load menu and the "dancing cutscene".
[*] Updated the info on the how to play menu (not Chinese or Greek)
[/list]

Now back to the developing the full game. This will be the last demo update we see until release... I think!

notes.title: Demo available on Linux!
notes.content:
Finally, I got to fixing the Linux build of the demo. The main issue we had was that the intro cut scene wouldn't play. After some correspondence with Unity and digging in support forums, we found that playing cut scenes on Linux builds were miraculously fixed in the latest update!
A bit annoying but also glad it was an easy fix! Which means a Linux version of the demo is LIVE on Steam. If you try it out let us know how it's behaving!

While adding that, we also fixed:
[list]
[*] 1 teeeeeny tiny bug - that no one luckily has reported on yet. Phew!
[*] Cleaned up some unused game assets
[*] Minor performance improvement on scene loading. Work is ongoing!
[/list]
Mooooo!

notes.title: Demo and Kickstarter release!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo and Kickstarter released![/h1]

Two weeks ago we launched the demo of A Trail of Ooze and the feedback has been absolutely amazing and so rewarding! Hearing what players think and getting feedback on the gameplay is invaluable to us. 
We have already used that feedback and made some minor bug patches and performance updates.

We hope you continue playing and let us know if you find that random Easter egg!
If you want to give us feedback we have a [url=discord.gg/AvU9NEsNeG]discord channel [/url]for this. Or just drop by to say hi! ːsteamhappyː


[h1]Kickstarter Oct 26 - Nov 25[/h1]
Today the Kickstarter campaign for A Trail of Ooze went live and we are currently about 25% backed!
Help us spread the word to raise some funds towards developing the full game!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/insantostudios/a-trail-of-ooze/]Back it here![/url]ːsteamthisː
